blocks.text: We are at the year 2013. What an amazing year 2012 was. Great weather changes and tragic events almost unbelievable have taken place. Events are happening so fast, accelerating at a speed that’s almost unbelievable. The changes coming in the next two years will dwarf all changes in the past. All nations are undergoing major structural financial changes. These processes will lead to an inflationary environment and a change coming to all currencies. If one would look at the trend of the Roman Empire, it is exactly what is happening to the world today. These important events will start in this year. For one event, announced by the U.S. government, they will no longer mint the one cent coin as well as the five cent coin. But that’s not all. They are no longer going to print the one dollar bill. In 2013 this will happen as announced by the government. They will still be in circulation from past minting and printing. Brother Frisby said it was very significant that the great seal on the back of the one dollar bill, showing the pyramid with the all seeing eye, placed in this nation, depicting the capstoning of this age. – According to NASA a solar eclipse coming on May 10, 2013 has a strange beginning with one lunar eclipse before it and one after it. We’ll go into more detail later. At the time of this letter the Federal Reserve is adding approximately $85 billion a month to the money supply, buying 90% of the U.S. bonds. They will be moving the debt ceiling towards $18 trillion. This does not cover any of the unfunded liabilities in the not too distant future. – Technology is advancing so fast that we are at the door of George Orwell’s 1984 type of world. And that brings us to an anti-Christ type system. – I have an important letter from Brother Neal Frisby’s library that I know you will enjoy.

“It is Christ or chaos! Will the climax come in our generation? Yes, according to the prophetic signs and by Jesus’ statement in Luke 21:28-32. Two main points in Jesus’ words are especially revealed. When the great prophecy spoken of begins to come to pass, God’s people are to begin to look up, for redemption is very nigh!” – “No one can deny this Scripture in Luke is rapidly taking place; but still more evident are the words of Jesus in verse 32, Verily I say unto you, this generation ‘shall not pass away’ till all be fulfilled! This verse definitely means the generation that sees these things begin to come to pass, shall see them also fulfilled!” “It means literally scores of people that ‘saw Israel go home’ and become a nation, will still ‘be alive’ to see the fulfillment of His return, the translation!” Now we are not giving an actual date. “One may not know the exact date of the starting of our generation but the truth is, it will climax during our generation!” “I know that we are in a transition period now that is soon to run out!” – “If you will remember when Halley’s Comet came through in 1910 we had two world wars and the rising of Adolph Hitler! And now, in the last cycle of its coming, 1986, we will have wars and then the Battle of Armageddon!” – “Jesus Himself said that there will be signs from the heaven denoting His soon return! Now this same comet came just before the birth of Christ and, since Israel has now become a nation again, we evidently will have seen this particular comet for the last time because all will have been fulfilled before it could ever possibly come again! We will see other comets but not this one!” “Oh what a time we are living in to witness the last events of our age!”

Scroll #106 gives us some real information concerning some of the things above, and we will list in part here. Quote – “It is said, the 22nd Jubilee marked the restoration of Israel by Nehemiah! – Daniel 9:25 prophesied it! – Now advancing further ahead, the 30th Jubilee is said to mark the announcement of the birth of Christ; evidently taking in His crucifixion and resurrection during this time wherein salvation set men free! Jubilee!” – NOW MOVING AHEAD IN THE FUTURE CONCERNING OUR TIME – “the 70th Jubilee, the final, should be occurring during the period from 1948 until the end of this last generation. – Although it may be a little sooner!” – “Israel became a nation in 1948 and they were free to have their own government. Israel’s returning to its possession sounds like a – Jubilee! Ending later with the feast of the Trumpets, Millennium!” – “There are however different opinions, but this one seems to be the most likely! Plus also remember the Translation of the Church occurs 3 ½ years to 7 years earlier than Israel’s rest in the Millennium! – According to Rev. 12 the Translation occurs in the midst of the 7 years!” – Luke 21:34-36: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be over-charged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares. For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth. Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man. – “Yes, indeed time is short for us to work!” End quote. – According to Brother Frisby’s scrolls there will be a climatic end to restructure this society.

This month I have a wonderful Special Writing called “Prophetic Future of World Events” as well as a wonderful DVD called “The Most High.” – I want to do all I can to publish this wonderful and vital message and I know your part will be rewarded and blessed by the Lord for all the effort that you have put forth in this ministry. I want to thank each and every one of you and may God’s continual blessings and wisdom be with all of His faithful servants. Continue to keep this ministry in your prayers.
